title: fix(ui): avoid duplicate publication and PR status rows
body:
## What Problem This Solves

The chat composer stacks a completed publication card above the merged PR, and can show changed files alongside PR history.

Related: #147195.

## User Impact

The composer shows unpublished changes or PR status using the existing compact row. Completed publication controls disappear once PR metadata is available. Errors, retries, and confirmation remain accessible inline.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use Gateway branch facts for unpublished work and current PR metadata for published work. Keep old receipts from hiding new changes or current CI, and acknowledge completed publication history when dismissing a PR so it cannot reappear as a second card.

## Evidence

- 37 component tests and 33 focused browser tests passed, covering publication, reconnect, account selection, confirmation, retries, new work after merging, and dismissal.
- Changed-file checks passed, including core test/UI type checks, lint, formatting, i18n verification, and dead-export scans. Independent Codex review is clean through P2.
- Before/after screenshots use synthetic data and the real UI component and styles; inspected at desktop and mobile widths. The full mocked Gateway browser flow also passed. No live Gateway deployment is included.

The initial [hosted CI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34868911447) hit a 10-second completion timeout in the unchanged cron/heartbeat test `drains coalesced cron and exec work without recurrence while retaining late arrivals`. All other jobs passed. The complete unchanged cron test file then passed locally (17 tests, original ordering); no source, mock, timeout, or assertion was changed. The failed-job-only retry passed on the same PR head, and the complete hosted CI run is green. The original failure evidence is retained; this PR does not claim to fix the unrelated cron timing issue.
